$comment: LLM function-calling manifest. Drop this into the `tools` array of an OpenAI / Anthropic / similar API call. Each tool corresponds to one cmd_type. The model should always populate `cmd_id` with a fresh UUID.

function.name: pick_place
function.description: Drive the chosen arm through a complete pick -> transport -> place cycle. Use pose_source='camera' and supply target_name to let the head 3D camera resolve the poses; or pose_source='upper_computer' and supply both grasp_pose and place_pose explicitly.

target_radius.description: Object sphere (m): pick.approach avoids grasp center, place.retreat avoids place center.

gripper_force.description: Gripper hold force during grasp (N); 0 uses controller default.

gripper_speed.description: Gripper speed scale during grasp; 0 uses default.

function.name: hand_water
function.description: Pick from behind and move to front hover (place.approach). Poses are fixed; specify left or right arm. Gripper stays closed and arm holds position — use separate gripper/home commands to release or return.

function.name: home
function.description: Drive both arms (or one) back to the SRDF home pose.

position.description: Optional explicit finger position in metres; overrides action.

force.description: Optional gripper force/hold strength; 0 uses controller default.

speed.description: Optional gripper speed scale; 0 uses default, smaller is slower.

function.name: stop
function.description: Emergency stop. Pre-empts any active pick_place and halts the controllers.
